label: VERIFIED
extraction: Cross-Team Orchestration (Croto): scalable multi-team framework enabling orchestrated teams to jointly propose task-oriented solutions and interact with insights in self-independent while cross-team collaboration environment. Each team has same task assignment to communicate in collaborative environment. Multi-team collaboration outperforms individual efforts. Aggregation process: multiple agents from different teams contribute solutions, partitioned into groups, collaboratively aggregated through interactions. Role-assigned aggregate agent proficient in synthesizing solutions extracts strengths/weaknesses of each solution, aggregates superior solution greedily integrating strengths and eliminating weaknesses, explicitly outlines changes. Related work: MAC-NET (Qian et al., 2024d) revealed quality follows logistic growth pattern as agent count scales. Croto envisions multi-agent teams as collaborative units enabling both inter- and intra-team collaborations.
